overview_description.description:
Munjz is a proptech solution that connects people looking for household services with pre-screened professionals. The company's app provides integrated maintenance services required by each house and facility, as well as an online marketplace for home services, enabling clients to obtain maintenance services for homes, facilities, and businesses, as well as annual maintenance packages for plumbing, electrical, air-conditioning, cleaning, furniture assembly, CCTV, and other services.

Munjz was established in 2017 in Dammam, Ash Sharqiyah by Abdullah AlDaij.

product.name: Munjz Connect
product.description: A flexible integrated platform for managing residential and commercial properties, facilitating operations, revenue, and communication.

product.name: Munjz Now
product.description: A comprehensive app offering over 200 maintenance and cleaning services, connecting users with qualified technicians for home repairs.

product.name: Munjz Market
product.description: A platform enabling service providers and suppliers to receive and manage operational requests in maintenance, cleaning, and contracting sectors.

product.name: Capital Projects Planning and Management
product.description: A service for planning and managing large-scale capital projects, including resource allocation, scheduling, and risk management.

product.name: Preventive Maintenance Management
product.description: A systematic approach to regularly inspect, maintain, and repair equipment and facilities to prevent unexpected failures.

product.name: Plumbing Services
product.description: Comprehensive plumbing services including installation, repair, and preventive maintenance of water systems and fixtures.
